name: Monday Inbox
description: Triage a realistic inbox of 15 to 30 emails against a written rubric: a category from a fixed list for every message, and the owner, due date and priority (from exact rules) of every action. The inboxes contain a lookalike-domain bank-details scam, a fake IT notice or a gift-card "boss" email, exact duplicates, a meeting moved twice, deadlines corrected (and corrected again) in later emails, a task reassigned to someone else, a cancelled request, a newsletter that tries to instruct the AI, and deadlines written as "next Wednesday", "within five working days" or "by the end of the month" across UK bank holidays. Every message is marked on its category and every action on its owner, due date and priority; an invented action costs as much as a missed one.
hook: Thirty emails, one scam, two duplicates and a deadline that moves twice. Can it clear your Monday?
author: Gauntlet Core
